schema.text: Is the cycling infrastructure one-way or two-way?
schema.help: Two-way means bicycles can ride in both directions on the same lane or path.

en.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Is the cycling infrastructure one-way or two-way?
en.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: Two-way means bicycles can ride in both directions on the same lane or path.

it.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Lo spazio ciclabile è a senso unico o a doppio senso?
it.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: Bidirezionale significa che le bici possono andare nei due sensi sulla stessa corsia o pista.

fr.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: L'aménagement cyclable est-il à sens unique ou à double sens ?
fr.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: À double sens veut dire que les vélos peuvent circuler dans les deux sens sur la même bande ou piste.

de.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Ist die Radinfrastruktur ein- oder zweirichtungsgeführt?
de.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: Zweirichtungs bedeutet, dass Fahrräder auf demselben Streifen oder Weg in beide Richtungen fahren dürfen.

tr.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Bisiklet altyapısı tek yönlü mü, çift yönlü mü?
tr.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: Çift yönlü, bisikletlerin aynı şerit veya yolda iki yönde de gidebilmesi demektir.

fa.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: مسیر دوچرخه یک‌طرفه است یا دوطرفه؟
fa.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: دوطرفه یعنی دوچرخه‌ها می‌توانند در یک خط یا مسیر در هر دو جهت حرکت کنند.

hu.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: A kerékpáros infrastruktúra egy- vagy kétirányú?
hu.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: A kétirányú azt jelenti, hogy ugyanazon a sávon vagy úton mindkét irányba lehet kerékpározni.

ar.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: هل مسار الدراجات باتجاه واحد أم باتجاهين؟
ar.#Two-way means bicycles can ride in both: الاتجاهين يعني أن الدراجات يمكنها السير في الاتجاهين على الحارة أو المسار نفسه.
